svg.title: Quadrify a regular quad chart
svg.desc: Rebuild a supported quad chart as an evenly spaced grid.. Actual add-on output on synthetic UV geometry. Uses mesh topology. Requires an integer-grid quad chart; arbitrary topology is not supported.

g.text: Rebuild a supported quad chart as an evenly spaced grid.
